a7sii_10.description: Sony a7S II, 19 frames 4240x2832 JPEG, static tripod, clear sky. The pilot's sequence, plus labels.json: 240 airplane/satellite streaks, all confirmed by hand, complete (the earlier a7sii_10-76013afcefe5 archive had the same frames without labels).
a7sii_10.provenance: Brian Martin, own photographs; labels by Brian Martin 2026-10-15.

a7sii_10_crop16.description: a7sii_10 as 16-bit LZW TIFF, every frame cropped to x=1500 y=600 w=2300 h=1450 of the original (all sky, no ground), plus labels.json: the a7sii_10 labels shifted into crop coordinates and clipped at the crop edge (122 objects, 31 of them clipped). Lossless input for the unchanged-outside check.
a7sii_10_crop16.provenance: Derived from a7sii_10 (Brian Martin, own photographs) with magick -crop 2300x1450+1500+600 -depth 16 -compress lzw.

a7sii_10_16bit.description: a7sii_10 converted to 16-bit LZW TIFF at full size (4240x2832, magick -depth 16 -compress lzw), plus labels.json: the a7sii_10 labels unchanged (240 objects) with .tif keys. Lossless input for the unchanged-outside check, without the crop's problems (BUGS.md BUG-001 to BUG-003).
a7sii_10_16bit.provenance: Derived from a7sii_10 (Brian Martin, own photographs); labels by Brian Martin 2026-10-15.

gui_splash_video.description: The gui's splash video (11_30_2024-fx3-aurora-topaz-star.mp4). A build input of Star.app, not test data.
